en.staff.21.300/staff/6000@0/description:
Debate Coach: Will highlight the best debate answer.

An attorney for the campaign and a White House Counsel for the Obama Administration who's willing to prep you for the debates against Donald Trump, which could be chaotic if you are unable to command the stage.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6001@1/description:
Kingmaker: Upon being hired your relationship with all lobbies with which you already have a positive relationship will be increased by 10.

A longtime advisor of yours, Ron Klain is eager to get into the White House, and will use his connections in Washington to get you there.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6002@2/description:
Fundraiser: Permanently increases the effectiveness of fundraising.

The former CEO of Dreamworks, Katzenberg has spent his whole life bringing dreams to life. You've always dreamed of the White House, haven't you? With a little cash, he can help that dream come true.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6003@3/description:
Smooth Talker: Permanently improves your RNG.

One of your chief rivals for the nomination, Pete Buttigieg dropped out before Super Tuesday to endorse your candidacy. In return, he wants a job in the White House. Until then, he's willing to stump for you.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6004@4/description:
Media Manager: Increases the effectiveness of ad campaigns.

The former spokeswoman and vice president of corporate communications at the Motion Picture Association of America, Kate Bedingfield knows the media biz better than anyone on your campaign, and could aid in your media strategy, especially in the midst of this national lockdown.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6005@5/description:
Spin Doctor: Opponent's visit effectiveness is cut in half.

A longtime ally of the Clintons, Dolan is a master of spin, and is interested in helping you take down Trump.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6006@6/description:
Surrogate: Provides a small boost in the state of Texas.

A popular congressman from San Antonio, Julián Castro would be willing to campaign throughout his home state of Texas in support of your candidacy.
en.staff.21.300/staff/6007@7/description:
Surrogate: Provides a small boost in the states of Michigan, Wisconsin, Ohio and Indiana.

The incumbent, popular governor of Michigan, Gretchen Whitmer is as much a darling of liberals as she is loathed by conservatives. Still, she would be willing to campaign throughout Michigan and its neighboring states in support of your campaign.
en.staff.21.300/lobby/7000@0/description: A group created by allies of Bernie Sanders' 2016 primary campaign that seeks to promote progressive candidates and policies.
en.staff.21.300/lobby/7001@1/description: The American Federation of Labour and Congress of Industrial Organizations is the largest federation of trade unions in the United States.
en.staff.21.300/lobby/7002@2/description: Bolstered by Democratic fundraiser and philanthropist Karla M. Jurveston, Emily's List seeks to promote women's reproductive healthcare in the United States.
en.staff.21.300/lobby/7003@3/description: An advocacy group for Arab-American interests, the ADC has recently taken an interest in opposing support for the state of Israel.
en.staff.21.300/lobby/7004@4/description: Since its formation in 2013, Black Lives Matter has made its lot in Washington supporting social justice for African-Americans.

zh.staff.21.300/staff/6000@0/description:
辩论教练：会突出显示最佳辩论回答。

他是竞选团队的律师，曾任奥巴马政府白宫法律顾问，愿意帮你准备与唐纳德·特朗普的辩论。如果你无法掌控舞台，辩论可能会变得混乱。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6001@1/description:
造王者：雇用后，你与所有已建立正面关系的游说团体的关系值提高10。

罗恩·克莱因是你多年的顾问，渴望进入白宫，会利用自己在华盛顿的人脉，帮助你走到那里。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6002@2/description:
筹款人：永久提高筹款效果。

梦工厂前首席执行官卡岑伯格，一生都在让梦想成为现实。你不也一直梦想着白宫吗？有一点资金，他就能帮助这个梦成真。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6003@3/description:
能言善辩者：永久改善你的随机判定运气。

皮特·布蒂吉格曾是与你争夺提名的主要对手之一，在超级星期二前退选，并支持你参选。作为回报，他想在白宫谋一份工作。在那之前，他愿意为你奔走助选。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6004@4/description:
媒体经理：提高广告宣传效果。

凯特·贝丁菲尔德曾任美国电影协会发言人和企业传播副总裁，比竞选团队中任何人都更了解媒体行业。她能帮助制定媒体策略，尤其是在这场全国封锁期间。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6005@5/description:
舆论操盘手：使对手的访问效果减半。

多兰是克林顿夫妇多年的盟友，擅长包装舆论，有兴趣帮助你击败特朗普。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6006@6/description:
助选代表：在得克萨斯州提供小幅加成。

朱利安·卡斯特罗是一位来自圣安东尼奥、很受欢迎的国会议员，愿意在家乡得克萨斯州各地为你助选。
zh.staff.21.300/staff/6007@7/description:
助选代表：在密歇根州、威斯康星州、俄亥俄州和印第安纳州提供小幅加成。

现任密歇根州州长格雷琴·惠特默很受欢迎。自由派对她有多喜爱，保守派就有多憎恶。不过，她仍愿意在密歇根州及邻州奔走，支持你的竞选。
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7000@0/description: 由伯尼·桑德斯2016年初选团队的盟友创建的组织，致力于推动进步派候选人和政策。
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7001@1/name: 美国劳工联合会—产业工会联合会
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7001@1/description: 美国劳工联合会—产业工会联合会，是美国最大的工会联合组织。
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7002@2/description: 在民主党筹款人和慈善家卡拉·M.·尤尔韦特松支持下，“艾米莉名单”致力于促进美国女性生殖医疗。
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7003@3/name: 美国阿拉伯裔反歧视联盟
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7003@3/description: 一个维护阿拉伯裔美国人利益的倡议团体。ADC最近开始关注反对支持以色列的问题。
zh.staff.21.300/lobby/7004@4/description: 自2013年成立以来，“黑人的命也是命”运动，在华盛顿致力于支持非裔美国人的社会公正。
